data.summary_en: Coding agents iteratively implement/evaluate and automatically design robot spatial memory construction/retrieval; under fixed development budget, Designer Agent rewrites code from fixed Query Agent feedback. Three independent design-searches: Codex/GPT-6 Astra averaged 44.23 on five-track equal-weight score vs. 29.32 for strongest all-five-track baseline ReMEmbR, 50.9% relative gain.
